soundness_flags.one_line: The cited RICOT source does not support the stated condition alone: its calibration-sieve analysis separately requires density-ratio smoothness above the one-dimensional half-smoothness threshold, whereas this product inequality permits t<=1/2.

source_verification_receipts.locator: §S4.3, proof following Theorem ST8 and Corollary ST10; v1 HTML rendering lines 1328 and 1357-1360
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The calibration-rate argument requires its density-ratio smoothness parameter to satisfy s>d/2 and separately imposes the outcome-rate condition beta+s/(2s+d)>1/2; it does not establish only the core's symmetric product inequality.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Either add the density regularity needed for the fixed-penalty RICOT sieve (in one dimension, the cited source's t>1/2-type requirement) or replace the citation and prove that the weaker product condition suffices for the proposed transport program.

Add Chen and Gao's 2026 Cowles discussion paper on minimax thin-set/submanifold integrals to related work and explicitly distinguish its weighted-design functional from the two-sample transport target; it is nearby non-archival work, not a subsuming theorem.
Give a finite computational reduction for the Hölder-ball multiplier supremum in the bias envelope, including its complexity or an implementable discretization with a proved conservative error.
